description: Read and write Figma files. Cosmo uses this in Phase 1 (ingest existing frames), Phase 2 (generate/update frames), and Phase 3 (audit).

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Get file metadata by fileKey. Args: (fileKey: string).

tools.name: get_frames
tools.description: List frames on a page. Args: (fileKey: string, pageId?: string).

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get a node by id. Args: (fileKey: string, nodeId: string).

tools.name: get_text_content
tools.description: Extract all text nodes under a subtree. Args: (fileKey: string, nodeId: string).

tools.name: get_components
tools.description: List component instances in a subtree with mainComponent key/name. Args: (fileKey: string, nodeId?: string).

tools.name: get_variables
tools.description: List variable/style bindings on a node. Args: (fileKey: string, nodeId: string).

tools.name: create_frame
tools.description: Create a frame. Args: (fileKey: string, pageId: string, name: string, size: {w:number,h:number}).

tools.name: insert_component
tools.description: Insert a component instance from the SFE library. Args: (fileKey: string, parentId: string, libraryKey: string, componentKey: string, props?: object).

tools.name: set_variable
tools.description: Bind a variable/style to a node. Args: (fileKey: string, nodeId: string, property: string, variableId: string).

tools.name: add_annotation
tools.description: Add a design-note annotation on a node (used for aria-label, focus order, etc.). Args: (fileKey: string, nodeId: string, text: string).

notes: Cosmo asks the user before writing to a Figma file the first time in a session.
Cosmo never writes during Phase 3 (audit) — audit is read-only. Writes only happen in Phase 2 and when the user says `apply fixes`.
Never log or echo the FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN. If the user pastes one, refuse and ask them to configure it in MCP env.
This is a template — replace `command` and env variable resolution with the values used by your Figma MCP implementation.
Cosmo retries each MCP call once on transient failure, then falls back to describe-only mode (Phase 2) or image-audit mode (Phase 3).
